en.p: A pouch contains 3 balls with the numbers 1, 2, 3 written on them, one each. A trial is performed in which one ball is drawn at random from the pouch, the number on it is checked, and the ball is put back. When this trial is repeated 5 times, the probability that the product of the 5 numbers checked is a multiple of 6 is $\dfrac{q}{p}$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
